info.title: Bank of Canada Valet
info.description: Bank of Canada Valet: the Bank's public, keyless JSON API for Canadian financial and economic time series. Used by the Bond Desk Recipe as the sovereign benchmark curve: the group `bond_yields_all` returns, in one call, the Government of Canada benchmark bond yields (2, 3, 5, 7, 10 year, long-term) and the marketable-bond average yields by maturity bucket (1-3y, 3-5y, 5-10y, over 10y), all in percent per annum. Observations are daily business-day values; `recent=1` returns the latest one. No API key. Every response carries a `terms` link: credit the Bank of Canada as the source when you republish a value.

get.summary: Latest observations for every series in a group (e.g. the whole benchmark yield curve)
get.description: Returns observations for all series in a Valet group. For the Bond Desk Recipe call it with groupName=bond_yields_all and recent=1: the single observation row then holds, keyed by series name, `BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD`, `BD.CDN.3YR.DQ.YLD`, `BD.CDN.5YR.DQ.YLD`, `BD.CDN.7YR.DQ.YLD`, `BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD`, `BD.CDN.LONG.DQ.YLD` (Government of Canada benchmark bond yields), `BD.CDN.RRB.DQ.YLD` (real return bonds) and `CDN.AVG.1YTO3Y.AVG`, `CDN.AVG.3YTO5Y.AVG`, `CDN.AVG.5YTO10Y.AVG`, `CDN.AVG.OVER.10.AVG` (marketable-bond average yields by remaining-maturity bucket). Each value `v` is a yield in percent per annum as a string; `d` is the observation date (YYYY-MM-DD). Other groups: `tbill_all` (treasury bill yields), `FX_RATES_DAILY` (daily exchange rates).

parameters.name: groupName
parameters.description: Valet group name, e.g. bond_yields_all, tbill_all, FX_RATES_DAILY.

200.description: Group metadata, per-series metadata and the observation rows.

groupDetail.label: Selected bond yields
groupDetail.description: Average yields for selected Government of Canada marketable bonds.

CDN.AVG.1YTO3Y.AVG.label: Marketable bonds average yield: 1 to 3 year
CDN.AVG.1YTO3Y.AVG.description: The average yield of Government of Canada marketable bonds with maturities between 1 and 3 years.

BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield: 10 year
BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond.

get.summary: Observations for one or more named series
get.description: Returns observations for the comma-separated series names in the path, e.g. `BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD,BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD`. Use `recent=1` for the latest value, or `start_date`/`end_date` for a window. Values are strings in the series' own unit (percent per annum for yields). An unknown series answers 404 with a `message`.

parameters.name: seriesNames
parameters.description: One series name, or several separated by commas.

200.description: Per-series metadata and the observation rows.

BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield: 2 year
BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 2-year benchmark bond.

BD.CDN.5YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield: 5 year
BD.CDN.5YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 5-year benchmark bond.

BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD.label: Benchmark bond yield: 10 year
BD.CDN.10YR.DQ.YLD.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond.

get.summary: Metadata for one series (label and description)
get.description: Returns the label and description of a single Valet series, without observations. Use it to confirm what a series measures before quoting it.

seriesDetails.name: BD.CDN.2YR.DQ.YLD
seriesDetails.label: Benchmark bond yield: 2 year
seriesDetails.description: The yield on the Government of Canada 2-year benchmark bond. This series reflects the prevailing interest rate for the 2-year term and is used to monitor short-term government borrowing costs.

get.summary: Metadata for one group and the names of the series it contains
get.description: Returns the group's label and description and the list of series names in it. Use it to discover series names before calling getGroupObservations or getSeriesObservations.

groupDetails.label: Selected bond yields
groupDetails.description: Average yields for selected Government of Canada marketable bonds.

recent.name: recent
recent.description: Return only the most recent N observations (N >= 1). Use 1 for the latest value. Non-numeric values answer 400.

order_dir.name: order_dir
order_dir.description: Sort order of the observation rows by date.

url.description: Bank of Canada terms of use; credit the Bank as the source.

Observation.description: One observation row: `d` is the date, every other key is a series name whose value object carries `v`, the value as a string in the series' unit.

example.message: Bad recent observations request parameters, must be numeric
